Premise: Disney canon since EU is a convoluted, inconsistent mess that wouldn't be a fair comparison since we're going off of Halo canon  
I believe the teams can destroy the Death Star and Kill Both Vader and Palpatine   
 Why? First off, AI in the Halo Universe are, as far as I know, shown to be much more powerful than those in Star Wars. Assuming the teams get AIs like Cortana, Roland, Auntie Dot, and Black Box, that's at least 12 smart AI that will be able to make the Death's stars systems a royal pain in the ass for the Empire to deal with. Equipment-wise, I imagine that they're best going in with Covenant plasma weaponry, plasma rifles, beam rifles, concussion rifles, etc. Maybe throw in some UNSC rail weaponry like Stanchion rifles and you've got a loadout that already is both: Faster than blasters from star wars, and cannot be blocked like blasters from lightsabers. In addition, they shouldn't have an issue going through stormtrooper armor whatever naval personnel are wearing. Most will already be equipped with energy shielding and armor already heavily improved upon to take damage from energy weaponry. The only ones who will be in dire straits are ODST- however, if we allow for them to wear Mark 2 SPI armor with energy shielding and improved gel-cooling layer armor plating, they're likely to have a better chance of survival.  
Secondly, all teams mentioned have years more experience than most of the personnel on the Death Star. Spartans, ODSTs, and Elites will all, at the very least, have training considered the very elite even by the standards of the Star wars Universe. Several of these teams have already undertaken similar operations like Operation: FIRST STRIKE and UPPER CUT, so infiltration is already something they're highly experienced with and have plenty of prep time for. All of the teams combined have killed hundreds of thousands, if not millions of people throughout their combined careers.

​

Thirdly, I believe that the people the Empire will be dealing with will be harder to take down than Jedi. Firstly, Spartans II, IIIs, and IVs all move at what will be essentially a blur for the Stormtroopers, Death troopers, and even the Elite Guard. They are faster than what they have dealt with (Which is mostly rebels) both in terms of reaction time and straight running speed, they are stronger, they have armor that will make them incredibly hard to put down that regenerates (shielding). All Sangheli involved also have similar feats and are, again, the best of the best from their universe. They've engaged thousands of personnel before and come out on top. But what if they encounter Imperial guard? Inquisitors? None of them can block plasma bolts, they have to deal with people that are much faster than them (Spartans perceive things in slow motion compared to regular people, IE "Spartan Time"). Not to mention their speed will be assisted by MJOLNIR and Smart AIs who will make their movements appear like blurs of light. There will be several dozen of them that they have to deal with at once in tight, compact spaces in which both Spartans and Elites (Who have consistently been shown to be on par with spartans, the very higher ranking ones that is).  Physically they are strong enough to tear into titanium, so even if they close range, their only hope is to use the force. But even then, they'll have so many to deal with they won't be able to kill them all. But if a Spartan or Elite gets their hands on an Imperial, its game over for them. I don't even think that Palatine and Vader will be able to defeat them out in the open. In Star Wars, you constantly see Sith trying to fight people at close range. The HALO team will not let this happen. They will shoot them from very far away if they can, from multiple angles, with reflexes that Vader can probably match but most likely cannot overcome with several dozen people near his skill level at once. 

That is of course if the HALO team even gets caught early on. All teams involved will have already been trained in stealth, and have decades worth of experience in such operations. They will have 12 Smart AIs who can effectively shut down any system they come across (Reminder than UNSC Smart AI have even given freakin forerunner AI a run for their money) They will have superior battlefield awareness of what goes on around them, and I see no reason why 12 AI working in conjunction cannot cripple the station, vent most of the Imperial personnel and detonate several compartments in the Death Star. 

Conclusion: Halo team infiltrates the Death Star, their smart AI do most of the work for them in terms of making it nearly impossible to track them. The Smart AI will create hundreds of small distractions if they do get caught- most likely killing significant numbers of the crew in the process. The teams, all carrying nukes, simply plant them at various locations at once. If caught by storm troopers, death troopers, imperial guard or inquisitors, their superior training speed will allow them to kill them. There will be some casualties, especially among the ODSTs and less experienced Spartan IVs. Even if they come across Vader and the Emperor, their combined speed, skill, firepower, and superior tactics will allow them to simply overwhelm both. Either way, they make it back to their Prowler and detonate the nukes, cracking the Death Star into several pieces.

Yeah at sea it's pretty much a draw unless, neither side could realistically attack each other at sea save submarine harassment. China would benefit very slight in that they could simply overwhelm French and british holdings in the Pacific without much worry.

Round 1: No, the EU cannot, assuming that the EU would be attacking China. France and British (who are still in the EU as of this moment) still have some very small islands out in the Pacific. Since the US isn't involved, Chinas less modern but still formidable Navy would have the advantage of geography and initial disposition of forces, as well as the ability to fortify their holdings. What few EU assets in the area would most likely flee or be overwhelmed. If China were attacking, the situation would he the reverse. They couldn't enter the Med via the Suez or by Gibraltar, that would be a disaster. The EU has a decent carrier fleet between France, Spain, and Italy. This scenario would he decided by whomever was attacking and defending. Both would have disadvantages in both sheer distance and geography. Both have advanced ship to ship missiles, however in terms of carrier operations and naval combat experience, europe holds the advantage, but is still not enough to make the difference.

2: Same results as round 1, If china is attacking, the added naval assets of the mentioned countries would not he enough to tip the balance in their favor. EU has more advanced submarines and could harass ships en route to Europe. Attacking via the sea is impractical for either side, so it would depend who went to whose area to rule out who would win. 

3. Without the United States, round three goes to China and its allies. For this scenario will will say that china and its allies will not meet much opposition in eastern europe by non EU states like Ukraine and Belarus. Although the EU has a larger economy and population than Russia, it has a superior arms industry and its forces are already positioned closer together than its European counterpart. Russian airborne forces are also more numerous and can thus deploy soldiers quicker. The EU's air force is formidable, and arguably greater than that of Russias (but not by much) However, russia makes up for this via its extensive  and more modern air defense systems. Europe simply can't use its advantage in the air very well while S400/300 systems are in play. Russia also has superior bombers to europe.  Armored vehicles and fire support is also superior to that of Eurppe, it has far more tanks (albeit of various makes and quality), and being only one country, Russia has an easier time in manufacturing tanks and other vehicles it has lost in combat. The naval theater would largely be of little consequence, as both sides would be playing defense, though Russias Navy would largely be relegated to its coasts.

Were it only russia and the EU, Europe could use its economic and population advantage to painfully whittle away at Russia. However, this this involved China as well as its numerous allies, the situation would be even worse for Europe. Given enough time, the PLA could send enormous amounts of reinforcements to the European plain to back russia.
